author: Declaration Desk
title: Trinamool MLA seeks CBI probe into Rs 1 crore cash find, alleges police planted it
dek: Magrahat West MLA Shamim Ahmed says he was pressed to give a statement against Abhishek Banerjee before the seizure at a party office in Sarisha.
body:
Shamim Ahmed, the Trinamool Congress MLA for Magrahat West in South 24 Parganas, filed a writ petition in the Calcutta High Court on Friday seeking a CBI investigation into the seizure of Rs 1,02,79,000 in cash from a party office at Sarisha, according to reports. Police found the money earlier this month in the Diamond Harbour police district.

In his petition, Mr Ahmed alleges the cash "was planted at the premises by the police administration", reports said. He says that on 2 November he met the superintendent of police of the Diamond Harbour police district, who asked him to give a statement against Diamond Harbour MP Abhishek Banerjee and his arrested aide, Sumit Roy. "I did not agree," he said. He says he fears arrest, citing the withdrawal of his police security.

Police have said the cash may be linked to an illegal soil-excavation case and have not said anyone has been charged over it. They had not responded publicly to Mr Ahmed's allegations by Friday evening. Mr Banerjee has also accused the state police of planting the money.

Reports have differed on Mr Ahmed's place in the divided Trinamool: one earlier report called him a rebel, while he has since written to the Election Commission reaffirming his allegiance to Mamata Banerjee's faction, according to reports. No hearing date has been reported.
